'''Raz''' was a short-tempered [[Duros/Legends|Duros]] [[Band/Legends|band]] leader for the group [[Raz and the Ubo-Kings]]. Raz and his band initially played on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], but Raz always felt that his talents were wasted playing as background music for the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] underworld deals and [[Cantina/Legends|barroom]] brawls. Eventually, Raz and his band would achieve stardom in [[Zakuul]].<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Raz is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' in the codex entry for Raz and the Ubo-Kings.<ref name="Codex" />
